name: My-Portfolio
description: Personal portfolio showcasing my projects, skills, achievements, and developer journey.

paragraphs: Welcome to the official repository of my developer portfolio. Built as an editorial, high-performance web experience featuring a technical bento-grid dashboard, dark/light theme switching, interactive command palette (Ctrl + K), dynamic project filtering, and real-time telemetry.
features: 🎨 Editorial Bento-Grid & Studio Layout: Aesthetic technical interface with glassmorphism, subtle micro-gradients, card tilt hover effects, and responsive layout.
🌓 Dual Theme Support: Seamless dark and light mode toggle with state persistence across sessions.
⌨️ Global Command Palette (Ctrl + K): Quick keyboard-driven navigation, section jumping, project search, and quick links.
🚀 Filterable Project Carousel: Tabbed filtering across full-stack web applications and hardware/embedded systems with live demo and source code links.
📈 Live GitHub Contributions & Telemetry: Dynamic GitHub metrics via API integration displaying commit activity and stats.
